title: Past experimental interbreeding between aliens and humans

tellings.quote: >> I got the impression that they had interbreeded before um experimentally.

plain: Aliens and humans have interbred in the past as an experiment. Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US government's signals intelligence agency, hired him around 1990 to 1993 to communicate with aliens, says he got that impression from those communications. If true, some humans would carry the results of earlier alien breeding experiments.
